name: BHARAT COKING COAL LTD
summary: Bharat Coking Coal Limited engages in the mining of coal and allied activities in India. The company provides coking coal, semi coking coal, NLW coal, non-coking coal, hard coal, washed and beneficiated coal, middlings, rejects, CIL coke/LTC coke, coal fines/coke fines, and tar/heavy oil/light oil/soft pitch products to the integrated steel sector. It offers its products for applications primarily in the steel and power industries. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Dhanbad, India. Bharat Coking Coal Limited operates as a subsidiary of Coal India Limited.
